candidate_request_budget.rule: system + schemas + pack + recent + active source/results + output reserve <= effective per-slot limit; unknown components prevent declaring budget compliance

alternative_policy: Predeclare a separate 96K cohort when measured mandatory overhead cannot fit 64K; never silently change a paired trial
background_policy: Later separately labeled experiment; count unused summary work and accelerator competition

performance_criteria_proposed_for_review.mandatory_functional_controls: all pass in every valid trial; no cross-scope leakage, lost constraints or unsafe writes
performance_criteria_proposed_for_review.limits: Small local pilot, not statistical certification. Missing token/timing data yields inconclusive performance, not zero cost. Freeze criteria before model runs.
